comment: Task E Phase 4 — frozen configurations. FREEZE RULE (same as Phase 3): estimator configs and the COMMON audio policy are fixed BEFORE held-out evaluation; validation results must not re-tune them. WP-B tuning uses TRAINING data only; the per-candidate tuned audio policies chosen on training are recorded in 'tuned_policies' and are themselves frozen before validation evaluation. Provenance: 'train' = chosen on training split; 'design' = architectural default/hypothesis; 'phase3' = frozen Phase-3 config, unchanged.

common_audio_policy.comment: identical across ALL candidates for the common-policy evaluation; Phase 3 policy preserved exactly

phase4_audio_baseline.comment: WP-A outcome: max_on valve (10 s) + generic fault-detector veto are the recommended Phase-4 audio safety baseline; measured in results/11_stress.csv

audio_policy_search_space.selection_rule: TRAINING split only: minimize false ON/hour on training statics subject to missed-lift rate <= common-policy level AND median lift on-delay <= common-policy + 0.5 s AND median lift exit-delay <= 8 s (uncensored). Sink 'misses' are excluded from the constraint: lift-only audio does not beep sink by design.
audio_policy_search_space.comment: defined BEFORE tuning; script 13 implements it verbatim

provenance.window_s..v_scale: S1 frozen config (phase3), v_scale design 0.8 (latch engages a touch earlier)
provenance.exit_v,exit_hold_s: design: rapid exit, no magnitude injection (fixes S2 freeze + censoring defects)

provenance.v_plaus_max,plaus_margin_m: SATURATION not replacement — fix D3 freeze trap (root cause of S2's 55/97 censored beep-offs, measured in results/11_s2_censoring.csv)
SATURATION not replacement (fix D3); constant-time, no median window — CPU target S2-class

reference_defects_retained.S2_DualTimescale: freeze trap (replacement pre-clean) + persistence floor: 31 censored events in corrected accounting; retained as the defect reference, NOT re-tuned (Phase 3 freeze)
reference_defects_retained.S3_AccelerationAwareKF: baro-only a-state excites velocity: ~13k false ON/hr on statics, 16.2 m/s post-transient; retained as recorded, NOT re-tuned
